meaning:
1) to exchange
1a) (Hiphil) to exchange
1b) (Hithpael) to enter into, be changed into
2) (TWOT) to promise

elsewhere.note: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.
